role_in_strategy: Alternative single combined software + validation paper
scope_and_article_types: Statistical software in any language; articles and code snippets; software and book reviews by invitation (secondary sources; scope wording not read on the official page)
software_and_replication_requirements: PDF in JSS style, source code, replication materials reproducing all results (ideally one commented standalone script; for R a code.html from knitr::spin ending with sessionInfo()); if the full replication is long, also a script reproducing similar results on a regular PC; code under GPL-2, GPL-3 or a GPL-compatible licence (MIT qualifies)
open_access_and_fees: Articles CC BY, authors keep copyright, code GPL; no author fees per DOAJ and secondary listings
review_timeline_evidence: No official current statistic found. DOAJ lists 53 weeks from submission to publication; SciRev (2 reports) 9 months first round, 15.1 months total; a 2014 blog analysis about 1.5 years
fit_for_this_project: Strong for a dual-language architecture plus validation paper; replication rules match an archived HPC study with a light replication script; slowest venue
evidence_status: partly_verified (official jstatsoft.org pages read only through search summaries; host blocked)

role_in_strategy: Second choice for the methods paper; first choice if a combined tool + validation paper is preferred over JSS
scope_and_article_types: Methods, techniques and instrumentation of research in experimental psychology, with a focus on computer technology (Psychonomic Society); original articles and tutorials
software_and_replication_requirements: Follows TOP Guidelines Level 2 since 2020 (data, code and materials transparency) and a type 4 research data policy (search summaries of Springer and Psychonomic pages)
open_access_and_fees: Hybrid (Springer). Springer Nature-Jisc agreement renewed for 2026-2028 with uncapped OA in more than 2,000 hybrid journals for authors at more than 120 UK institutions; Oxford's participation and BRM's inclusion not confirmed
review_timeline_evidence: journalmetrics.org (PubMed-derived, 2024-2025): median 223 days submission to acceptance (IQR 168-337). Psychonomic page: average submission to first decision about 46-64 days for 2021-2023 (text garbled)
fit_for_this_project: Best audience fit (psychology, psycholinguistics, education methods users); has published LMM simulation tools
evidence_status: partly_verified (link.springer.com and psychonomic.org blocked; search summaries only)

venue: Advances in Methods and Practices in Psychological Science (AMPPS)
role_in_strategy: Optional tutorial paper ('auditing a mixed-model design before fitting'), or the methods paper if framed as research practice
scope_and_article_types: Methods, practices and metascience across psychology; general articles, empirical articles (often registered reports) and tutorials; research-practice pieces include statistics tutorials, articles on new research tools and simulation studies for new techniques
software_and_replication_requirements: Code needed to reproduce simulations, analyses or results; materials, code and de-identified data as public as possible; open-source tools strongly encouraged for tutorials
open_access_and_fees: Fully open access; APC stated as USD 1,000 on the APS page and USD 1,500 on the SAGE page (conflict unresolved); no Jisc agreement found (the ESAC 'aps2026jisc' entry is the American Physical Society)
fit_for_this_project: Good for a hands-on tutorial with the packages; reaches the same audience as BRM
evidence_status: partly_verified (psychologicalscience.org and sagepub blocked; search summaries only)

role_in_strategy: First choice for a separate methods paper reporting the preregistered validation study
scope_and_article_types: 'Devoted to the development and dissemination of methods for collecting, analyzing, understanding, and interpreting psychological data'; theoretical, quantitative, empirical and methodological articles, reviews of methodological issues, tutorials, innovative applications, teaching articles and reviews of statistical software
software_and_replication_requirements: APA journals implement TOP Guidelines; APA has required TOP disclosure in the Methods section since autumn 2023; the journal's own TOP level and code rules were not retrieved
open_access_and_fees: Hybrid (APA). APA-Jisc OA pilot ran 1 Aug 2024 to 31 Jul 2026 with an annual cap; a 2026-2029 APA resources tender was published in March 2026 (terms unknown); Oxford participation not confirmed
review_timeline_evidence: Not found (APA publishes journal operations statistics; not retrieved)
fit_for_this_project: Best for generalisable findings about LMM diagnostics and decision rules (operating characteristics across designs); weaker for describing software
evidence_status: partly_verified (apa.org blocked; scope quoted from search summary of the official page)

role_in_strategy: First choice for the software paper (both packages in one paper), submitted once the eligibility gates are met
scope_and_article_types: Research software with an obvious research application; the paper must not focus on new research results; feature-complete, packaged to community standards; minor utilities and single-function packages not accepted
software_and_replication_requirements: OSI licence; public repository with issues; desk-rejection gates: more than 6 months of public development history, evidence of research use (at least by the developers), good open-source practice (for single authors: commit history, releases or changelog, tests and CI, documentation, CONTRIBUTING, governance statement) and iterative development; paper 750-1,750 words with Summary, Statement of need, State of the field (build-versus-contribute justification), Software design, Research impact statement and AI usage disclosure; archived release with DOI on acceptance
open_access_and_fees: Diamond OA; no submission or publication fees
review_timeline_evidence: Open review on GitHub; authors expected to respond within 2 weeks and finish changes within 4-6 weeks; no overall duration stated
fit_for_this_project: Cheapest route to a citable software paper for one maintainer; co-publication with a methods paper allowed if the software reflects substantial effort and related papers are disclosed
evidence_status: verified (docs/submitting.md, docs/paper.md, docs/policies.md from github.com/openjournals/joss, main branch, read 2026-11-07)

role_in_strategy: Not recommended for this project (R-only); possible later for an R-specific article
scope_and_article_types: Must be primarily about R packages and R programming; up to 20 pages; packages, reviews and proposals, comparisons and benchmarking, applications, special issues
software_and_replication_requirements: Package on CRAN or Bioconductor with demonstrated use and community input; unit tests that check output values; full documentation; a vignette; version-control URL in DESCRIPTION; few dependencies; actively maintained and mature; reproducible in under 10 minutes (supply intermediate outputs for heavy computation); rjtools R Markdown template (Quarto template planned); abstract <= 250 words; not published or submitted elsewhere
open_access_and_fees: Peer-reviewed open-access journal of the R Foundation; fees not stated on the pages read
review_timeline_evidence: About 150 submissions a year; review 'might take several months'; median time from submission to acceptance under a year
fit_for_this_project: Poor fit for the dual-language parity story; desk-rejection risk for young packages (time on CRAN, maturity)
evidence_status: verified (submissions.Rmd and index.Rmd from github.com/rjournal/rjournal.github.io, master branch, read 2026-11-07)
